scope.definition: Every numbered exercise in the end-of-chapter Problems sections, including all labeled questions, cases, and requested proof steps; all unlabeled requests within each exercise remain in scope. Worked examples and theorem proofs outside Problems sections are not separately numbered exercises.
scope.backmatter: Bibliography, List of Symbols, Index; no appendices or additional exercise sets.

errata.limitations: The companion site named in the second-edition preface was inaccessible. No author/publisher second-edition errata list was verified. This does not establish that none exists. Mathematical ambiguities must be documented in individual solutions.

source_review_policy.warning: Text extraction is a navigation aid only. Tables, diagrams, and some mathematical glyphs can disappear or become corrupted. Authors and reviewers must inspect original PDF pages, including every figure/table and displayed formula, before accepting a solution.
source_review_policy.visual_dependency_flag_method: Image blocks and substantial vector drawings intersecting the exercise body identify possible visual data, with manual overrides for confirmed omissions. The absence of a visual_dependency flag does not establish that extracted text is complete.
